title: Crazy Crafting Table
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel. Crafting Table has limit, And it can be a monster.
body:
This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel.
The Crafting Table now has a usage limit. After crafting about 10 items, the table refuses to work unless you pay it with Emeralds. If you try to force it to craft without paying, it may turn into a hostile entity and attack you.
